name: What doorway width do I need for wheelchair access?

mainEntity.name: What doorway width do I need for wheelchair access?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important measurement is the clear opening, because that is what determines whether a wheelchair or walker can pass through safely. Accessibility guidance commonly uses a minimum clear opening of 32 inches, and many home modification programs prefer widening to 36 inches when possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the clear opening, not the door label size. A 32-inch clear opening is the common minimum for accessibility, and 36 inches is often the preferred target when the structure allows it.
